verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say you can "watch spend in real time" on issued cards, and that receipts and categories are captured "as soon as you swipe." They also claim real-time visibility into per-vendor SaaS spend. MCP and the CLI support transaction search by merchant, with department and category data plus prompts like "top software vendors by spend this quarter," so card spend is visible the day it happens rather than at statement time. missing for 10: an explicit first-party spend dashboard or report broken down by team/department (team views are only implied via department data), documented category-level reporting views, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time latency.
